newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Niugini, Battle Mountain cease talks.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Niugini, Battle Mountain cease talks.

text.p: Gold miner Niugini Mining Ltd said on Friday merger discussions with its 50.4 percent shareholder, Battle Mountain Gold Co, had been discontinued.

Niugini said a number of alternative deal structures had been explored since Battle Mountain announced its interest in acquiring full ownership, but the potential indicated price of about A$4.00 per Niugini share was insufficient for directors to recommend any offer to shareholders.
The company said it was pursuing other corporate initiatives with a view to optimising shareholder value.
By 1.05 p.m. (0305 GMT), Niugini shares were 20.5 cents lower at A$3.615 on turnover of 3,217 shares.
